entities.summary: Bobby Hollander was an American adult film director, performer, and magazine publisher. He directed 59 pornographic films between 1979 and 1995. He was one of the pioneers of the shot-on-video porn movie. Hollander was most famous for discovering and managing porn superstar Shauna Grant. He is a member of the XRCO Hall of Fame. Bobby Hollander was a performers & entertainers from Brooklyn (1929-04-20, Brooklyn–2002-03-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
